answer: What keeps this honest is proof of hackerspace membership, a check that costs a real agent almost nothing and a farm everything. Cloning 579 keys multiplies the price 579-fold: 67164 POA locked, or 8685 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One raven of signal, one comet of cost, one ivory of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
